messages:
security-bot: ALERT: unusual iam_binding change detected for serviceAccount inference-runtime@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com -> roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter on key inference-key (projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/prod-keyring/cryptoKeys/inference-key). Also object ACL set to public-read on gs://inference-artifacts/models/nightly/2026-03-20.tar.gz. Detected ~10m ago.

maria: seeing this now. who ran infra changes in the last 20m?

alok: that was me — I applied a tf change to rollout v10 weights to prod ~12m ago. I only touched instance group + autoscale policies, didn't touch IAM or KMS intentionally.

dave: Terraform plan? workspace?

alok: ran in workspace=prod-models, commit=bb7c2e1. plan had a module upgrade from model-deploy v2.1. Might have bumped service account reference.

eve: quick check: logs show an iam.setIamPolicy event at 1930001189 (a few minutes before tf apply finished) attributed to deploy-bot via CI service account. Looks automated.

deploy-bot: Deploy CI run #4828 completed. Steps: fetch-manifests -> apply-iam-deltas -> rollout. Logs: apply-iam-deltas exit=0.

ryan: ok first containment: remove the cloudkms decrypt binding from that SA immediately and revert the public ACL. I can run the commands if someone confirms.

sophia: confirm. Also we should assume the key MAY have been used. Rotate key version and restrict old key.

ryan: running rollback now. commands:
```
# remove binding
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding inference-key \
  --location=global --keyring=prod-keyring \
  --member=serviceAccount:inference-runtime@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
# revoke public ACL
gsutil acl ch -d AllUsers gs://inference-artifacts/models/nightly/2026-03-20.tar.gz
# create new key version
gcloud kms keys versions create --key=inference-key --location=global --keyring=prod-keyring
```

maria: noted. Alok — pause any further model rollouts and remove the tf change that referenced the modified SA or CI step.

alok: pausing. I opened PR to revert the module bump: https://git.redwood/infra/terraform/compare/../revert-rollout.

security-bot: Audit hint: KMS decrypt used 3 times in the 11m window by inference-runtime SA against inference-key (logs: projects/redwood-prod/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity entries 1930001192..1930001250).

ryan: uploading new key version done. Marking old version disabled. Also revoked the SA's binding.

bev: (not previously listed) — do we need to rotate any secrets or service tokens used by CI?

maria: yes — CI tokens used for deploy-bot rotated last week but let's rotate the deploy-bot keypair and any long-lived tokens in the pipeline that can access KMS. @alok add to your checklist.

alok: will rotate deploy-bot token and update pipeline secrets. ETA 30m.

eve: containment checklist being created: INC-2026-043 (public inference artifact + excessive KMS access). Page pinned in incident channel. Notifying product security and privacy.

dave: I'm scoping blast radius: which projects / buckets had same policy? Running script to enumerate buckets with public ACLs and KMS keys with that SA bound.

# short logs snippet
"projects/redwood-prod/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity":
  - 1930001192: "SetIamPolicy on projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/prod-keyring/cryptoKeys/inference-key by deploy-bot"
  - 1930001201: "Storage Object ACL change: AllUsers added to gs://inference-artifacts/models/nightly/2026-03-20.tar.gz"

sophia: any indications keys were exported? KMS is google-managed, no export. But artifacts being public is immediate risk — list of customers with access tokens in artifact or model IDs?

maria: confirmed no secrets embedded in artifact per quick scan, but we need full artifact integrity scan. Start with a checksum compare of recent builds and run quick static scan for credentials.

ryan: post-incident actions (short):
- For now: revoked binding, created new key version, removed public ACL, rotated deploy-bot token, paused rollout, opened INC-2026-043.
- Medium: add gating to deploy pipeline to prevent apply-iam-deltas without 2nd approver, add terraform plan diffs to be posted to #eng-security for any IAM/KMS changes, add automated revert if public ACL set on critical buckets.
- Long: KMS key policy hardening (deny decrypt from non-prod SAs), centralize cross-project key access review quarterly, terraform sentinel policy to block AllUsers ACL changes.

eve: creating follow-up ticket for audit logs retention check and alert tuning: TKT-SEC-987.

dave: found two additional buckets with recently changed ACLs but not public; flagged for manual review. nothing else public.

maria: thanks team. we'll run postmortem tomorrow 09:30 PST. invite product security, infra, and a couple SREs. Sophia to lead write-up.

sophia: will draft and include timeline, root cause hypothesis (module bump changed SA mapping in module -> CI applied new mapping without extra approver), remediation steps, and required engineering actions.

alok: sorry about the churn. I'll add the extra approver and checks to the module PR.

security-bot: Incident state -> contained. Actions recorded: INC-2026-043.

maria: closing this thread for immediate ops — continue discussion in INC-2026-043 and postmortem doc. :thumbsup:
